name: tscaps
creator: francozanardi
category: Subtitles, transcription, dialogue cleanup, and automatic editing
description: Browser subtitle editor with local Whisper transcription, animated captions, SRT export and burned-in video export. Useful alongside Resolve through subtitle/media files; it does not create editable Fusion captions.
display_description: Browser subtitle editor with local Whisper transcription, animated captions, SRT export and burned-in video export. Useful alongside Resolve through subtitle/media files; it does not create editable Fusion captions.
platform_notes: Requires a supported WebCodecs browser. Editor is AGPL-3.0; engine/templates MIT. First use downloads transcription models.
